title: Fix CmdPal extension installed state detection for Store-only package…
summary: Community CmdPal PR has a valid demo, linked issue, CLA, and reported successful Azure builds, but the live pr-intake check is failing. Fork-side review found two independent failure-isolation bugs and missing direct coverage; the runtime fixes build successfully, while Copilot convergence remains blocked by two unresolved test-coverage findings and no fresh review after the fixes.

status.label: Review blocked — Copilot convergence incomplete
status.detail: Fork PR 484 is at c070fd3c3. Three runtime/edge-case findings were fixed and rebuilt; two test-coverage findings remain unresolved. The fresh review request returned no requested reviewer, so a zero-comment current-head review cannot be obtained.

next_action: Enable Copilot code review on the fork or complete the remaining direct service/gallery coverage, then request a fresh review before any upstream action.

confidence.rationale: The fork Copilot finding reproduces the Task.WhenAll failure path, and the upstream lambda has no per-ID exception boundary.
The upstream pass-level catch surrounds the entire snapshot loop, so one package inspection exception can skip all later entries.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add direct coverage for Store lookup behavior

**Severity:** `medium`

The added gallery test verifies only that a Store ID is dispatched to a mock. Please add focused coverage for the service implementation and the gallery state mutation, including case-insensitive normalization and de-duplication, one failed lookup alongside a successful lookup, installed versus not-installed packages, and an inspection failure. This can be a follow-up if an injectable WinGet catalog seam is needed.

safe_actions: Hold all upstream posting until Copilot review is enabled and the fork loop reaches zero new comments and zero unresolved threads.
Do not approve or modify microsoft/PowerToys from this artifact.
After the remaining coverage work, re-request review against the exact live head and revalidate all comment ranges.

test_instructions: Open Command Palette and navigate to the Extension Gallery.
Verify a Store-only extension with a Store ID is shown as Installed when present, while an unavailable package remains not installed.
Exercise multiple Store-only entries where one catalog lookup or status inspection fails and verify other entries still receive an independent status.
